appDescription.message: Reduce accidental Enter-key sends in Gemini, Gemini Notebook, Google Flow, and standalone Google Chat.

sidePanelNotice.message: Supports Gemini, Gemini Notebook, Google Flow, and standalone Google Chat. It does not apply to the browser's built-in Gemini side panel or Google Chat in Gmail.

flowShortcutNotice.message: Command-key sending shortcuts are currently not supported in Google Flow.
